<style>
.avz { border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px 4px; margin: .5rem 0 1.5rem; background: #fff; }

.avz .pcm .avz-top { opacity: .12; }
.avz .pcm .avz-low { fill: #2a9d5c; }
.avz .col { transition: opacity .4s; }
.avz .strip { transition: stroke .3s, stroke-width .3s; }

.avz .fft.on { opacity: 1; }

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById('avz'), NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  var bits = root.querySelectorAll('.avz-bit');
  var bars = [root.querySelector('.b0'), root.querySelector('.b1'), root.querySelector('.b2')];
  var sum = root.querySelector('.sum'), drop = root.querySelector('.drop');
  var cols = root.querySelector('.cols'), strip = root.querySelector('.strip'), fft = root.querySelector('.fft');
  var NCOL = 60, KEEP = 23, PITCH = 5, X0 = 640, MID = 120;   // 60 columns stand for 512 samples; 23 = the 200-sample overlap
  var amps = [], n = 0;
  function amp(i) { return 46 * Math.sin(i * 0.42) * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(i * 0.06)); }
  function T(el, x, y, sx, sy, op) {
    el.style.transform = 'translate(' + x + 'px,' + y + 'px) scale(' + sx + ',' + sy + ')';
    if (op !== undefined) el.style.opacity = op;
  }
  function snap(el, f) { el.classList.add('snap'); f(); void el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.classList.remove('snap'); }
  function wait(ms) { return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); }); }
  function render() {
    while (cols.firstChild) cols.removeChild(cols.firstChild);
    amps.forEach(function (a, i) { addCol(i, a); });
  }
  function addCol(i, a) {
    var r = document.createElementNS(NS, 'rect');
    r.setAttribute('class', 'col'); r.setAttribute('x', X0 + i * PITCH); r.setAttribute('width', PITCH - 1);
    r.setAttribute('y', a >= 0 ? MID - a : MID); r.setAttribute('height', Math.max(Math.abs(a), 1));
    r.setAttribute('fill', '#2a9d5c'); cols.appendChild(r); return r;
  }
  function push() { var a = amp(n++); amps.push(a); addCol(amps.length - 1, a); }
  for (var i = 0; i < KEEP; i++) push();
  async function cycle() {
    // three I2S frames give three 18-bit samples that stack up
    for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      bits.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.add('hot'); });
      snap(bars[k], function () { T(bars[k], 25, 71, 5 / 9, 1, 1); });
      await wait(350);
      T(bars[k], 380, 58 + 26 * k, 1, 1);
      await wait(250);
      bits.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('hot'); });
      await wait(550);
    }
    // they add into one 20-bit sum
    snap(sum, function () { sum.classList.remove('pcm'); T(sum, 362, 84, 1, 1, 0); });
    bars.forEach(function (b) { T(b, 380, 84, 1, 1, 0); });
    T(sum, 362, 84, 1, 1, 1);
    await wait(900);
    // the top 4 bits go: 16-bit pcm
    sum.classList.add('pcm');
    await wait(800);
    // it shrinks to one sample and drops into the frame
    var a = amp(n), x = X0 + amps.length * PITCH;
    snap(drop, function () { T(drop, 398, 84, 144, 16, 1); });
    T(sum, 362, 84, 1, 1, 0);
    T(drop, x, a >= 0 ? MID - a : MID, PITCH - 1, Math.max(Math.abs(a), 1), 1);
    await wait(750);
    push(); drop.style.opacity = 0;
    // more samples arrive the same way until the frame is full
    while (amps.length < NCOL) { push(); await wait(55); }
    strip.classList.add('full'); fft.classList.add('on');
    await wait(1100);
    strip.classList.remove('full'); fft.classList.remove('on');
    // keep the newest 200 samples for the next frame
    var gone = Array.prototype.slice.call(cols.children, 0, NCOL - KEEP);
    gone.forEach(function (c) { c.style.opacity = 0; });
    T(cols, -(NCOL - KEEP) * PITCH, 0, 1, 1);
    await wait(800);
    amps = amps.slice(NCOL - KEEP);
    snap(cols, function () { T(cols, 0, 0, 1, 1); render(); });
    await wait(400);
  }
  if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    while (amps.length < NCOL) push();
    return;
  }
  (async function () { while (true) await cycle(); })();
})();
</script>
